class: Consent question mentioning a number matched as contact data
symptom: The correctly recognized SMS consent question was offered the applicant's phone number as its Yes/No answer.
root_cause: Phone concept and fallback matching treated mobile number in the consent wording as a request for the number. The existing text-contact preference rule covered checkboxes only.
why_tests_missed: Text-message consent tests did not exercise Yes/No radio and dropdown fields whose wording also mentioned a mobile number.
fix: SMS choice questions use an exact approved saved answer or the existing contact-preference policy; phone matching excludes SMS consent wording.
prevention: Verify semantic answer type and actual committed radio state with a synthetic profile before calling a planner.
